exclusion_policy.collectible: Only source records with collectible=true are roots.
exclusion_policy.future_releases: Exclude unreleased sets and preview/event cards until they are usable in Standard on the as_of_date, except explicit card IDs above; apply explicit excluded_card_ids even when metadata assigns a current set.
exclusion_policy.tokens_and_generated_cards: Not roots; add them later only through reachable dependency analysis.
exclusion_policy.bans: Deckbuilding bans are a separate legality axis and do not remove cards from the collectible Standard root pool or generation pools.

sources.claim: Year of the Scarab (2026) and Year of the Raptor (2025) sets are in Standard & Wild; the October 2026 expansion is listed as upcoming.
CATACLYSM starts Year of the Scarab; Year of the Pegasus rotates out; Core and Event Set pools update.
Escape from Violet Hold Class Sets release on August 25; Arena pool lists Escape from Violet Hold, CATACLYSM, Across the Timeways, The Lost City of Un'Goro, Into the Emerald Dream, and Event Set.
Reign of the Black Empire launches October 20; M.O.T.H.E.R. (BE_036) is granted early. Future event cards are scheduled for October 6.
Active Standard/Wild ban list contains only Grove Shaper and Godfrey the Betrayer under Wild; Standard list is empty.

notes: Set IDs are the project's HearthstoneJSON/RosettaStone identifiers. Their membership must be reconciled with the dated source snapshot before accepting generated root counts.
BE_036 is retained as the project's documented one-card early-access Standard exception; no other BE cards are included on this date.
